build_FCBlock_MLP: build a multi-layer perceptron with FCBlock using Kaiming-normal initialized linear layers and LayerNorm
build_Unet_2D_segmentation: build a 2D U-Net segmentation model with configurable downsampling stages and upsampling mode
build_Unet3d_3D_segmentation: build a 3D U-Net segmentation model with configurable downsampling stages and max channels
create_DownsamplingNet_feature_pyramid: create a downsampling network that builds a feature pyramid with strided convolutions and dropout
create_UpBlock_transpose_conv: create a 2D upsampling block with transpose convolutions, batch norm, and optional pixel shuffle
